scene.name: Pick a mould
scene.purpose: Choose one of six clearly distinct shapes and preserve an editable recipe.
on_enter: Require a draft ID. If absent, create a fresh draft before rendering choices.
Load six shape previews and active mould; default cube selected on new drafts.
Access uses earnedUnlocks union temporaryFreePlayAccess; locked items can be inspected without starting a purchase.
on_exit: Persist selected mould and seed; release turntable selection animation.
scene.persistence: Write draft.recipe.mouldId, recipeRevision, dirty fields and lastStep=03. Shape change invalidates fill/reveal/photo validation but keeps colour/material/inclusion IDs and seed.
scene.back_rule: Back returns 02 with draft intact. Next goes 04. Editing an existing saved toy first creates a remix draft; never edits a saved recipe in place.
acceptance: Cube, blob and heart start usable; star/cloud/bear obey discovery access.
Changing shape keeps compatible choices and deterministic inclusion layout.
All six choices are reachable in simple and expanded modes.
implementation_notes: Generated scene-02 tray is a station prop, not six independent mould meshes. Commission/export the six actual mould sources listed in the asset master.
Simple mode paginates three choices per tray row; the six registered positions remain the expanded tablet layout.

actions.trigger: Tap choice, keyboard activate, or select from simple-mode paged tray
actions.guard: Item unlocked or Free Play access; reject unknown catalogue IDs
actions.command: draft.setMould(id); remap interior anchors from recipe seed; invalidate dependent completion flags
actions.feedback: 250–350ms lift; selected outline/check; optional spoken shape.
actions.interrupt: New choice supersedes previous tween; only committed selected ID persists.

actions.command: Show pictorial milestone and Back; never route to real-money flow
actions.feedback: One item preview, current/required creation count.

actions.interrupt: On checkpoint error retain in-memory draft and show recoverable storage notice.

actions.command: Replay short mould lift; no recipe change
